page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Hebrew, Syriac and Latin, running from top to bottom; a catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes. Page number at top right, running head at top left.

main_text.p: סאובא, סאובתא, סאובא [?] & contracte סובתא Ch. Idem.
סאבור Ch. Idem, Levit. 14.19. in Jon.

סאה סאתא Ch. Satum, modius, mensura aridorum proprie: Syriac. ܣܐܬܐ Subter modium, Matth. 5.15. & Mar. 4.21. Lucæ 11.33. Deinde etiam latius pro quavis mensura usurpatur, ut ויסחי בארבעין סאין רמוי Lavabit in quadraginta mensuris vel haustris aquæ, Exod. 29.4. Lev. 15.5.6.7. & 16.28. in Tar. Jon. Plur. masc. סאין & Hierosol. quoque סאין סוין in Jon. sæpius, Syr. ܣܐܝܐ Sata, Matt. 13.33. & Luc. 13.21. & fœmin. סאין. Duale סאתן Duo sata, 1. Reg. 18.32.
סאם סאמא Ch. Argentum, Prov. 17.3. Idem quod סים. Sic legitur etiam Syr. ܣܐܡ, 1. ad Cor. 3.12. ܥܒܕ ܣܐܡ Faber argentarius, Act. 19.24.
סאן ܣܐܢ Syr. Calceavit, calceos induit, Act. 12.8. Ephes. 6.14. Aphel ܐܣܦܚ Et calceate eum, Lucæ 15.22.
סינא, סין Chal. Calceus, calceamentum. Plur. סיני, סינין Calcei, Belg. Schoen Germ. Schuh.
סין Ch. Idem. Plur. סיניא, סינין Jesa. 3. 18. Syr. ܣܝܢܐ & Ch. fœm. סינין Esth. 5.1. in Targ. sec.
סבא Hebr. Potare, Ingurgitare se. Partic. סבי חמר Potator vini, Deuter. 21.20. Hinc German. Sauffen.

page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew words are reproduced from the scan with low confidence; several vowel-pointed forms and the Syriac script are approximate and should be checked against the original. The Latin and German text is clear. Faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored. The word "Sauffen" is set in black letter.
